lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with the highest density of large-diameter blobs along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid pattern where blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge positioned on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity values on the superior edge and low-intensity values (shadowing) on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A non-uniform distribution of high-luminance circular clusters visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered towards the anterior base and mid-section of the fin silhouette.
